items.label: U.S. House
items.text: U.S. Representative 2013 to 2019 and since January 3, 2021; represented the 21st District and, since 2023, the 22nd District. (sources: U.S. House History, Art & Archives https://history.house.gov/People/Detail/15032387819 [search summary, primary]; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Valadao [search summary, secondary])

items.label: California State Assembly
items.text: Member of the California State Assembly, 30th District, 2010 to 2012. (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Valadao [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Dairy
items.text: Partner in Valadao Dairy with his brother since 1992; managing partner. (sources: Office of Rep. David Valadao (house.gov) https://valadao.house.gov/about/ [search summary, primary]; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Valadao [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Education
